Horizon M1 - quick install
==========================

Horizon is an unofficial native (Rust) version of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3.
This build is tuned for Apple Silicon Macs (M1/M2/M3/M4) with 8 GB of memory.
You need Minecraft: Java Edition. Horizon contains no Minecraft files: it makes
them on your Mac from your own copy.

1. Right-click "Install Horizon M1.command" and choose Open, then Open again.
   (macOS 15 or newer may block it: open System Settings > Privacy & Security,
   scroll down, click "Open Anyway", then try again.)
2. A Terminal window opens. Follow it:
   - pick a look: 1 full (all packs + shader), 2 fast, 3 plain;
   - type 1 for a Microsoft account (normal), then sign in and press Play
     in the Horizon launcher that opens;
   - or type 2 for Offline (no sign-in), pick a player name, and play with
     "Horizon Offline" in your Applications folder. Offline needs Minecraft
     Java 26.3 installed and launched once in a Minecraft launcher.
3. Your worlds live in ~/Library/Application Support/horizon

Full guide, troubleshooting and uninstall: https://github.com/tm-droid/horizon-m1#readme
Credits and licenses: the LICENSES folder.
